decisions.decision: Keep broad bounded fuzz generation and stop on every exact mismatch.
decisions.rationale: Narrowing to corpus-proven inputs would hide defects and violate behavioral-equivalence scoring.

decisions.decision: Pin oracle checkout bytes to CRLF with .gitattributes instead of normalizing hashes.
decisions.rationale: The kickoff manifest hashes raw CRLF working-tree bytes; CI must reproduce that byte contract.

decisions.decision: Run `deno test test.js` explicitly in CI.
decisions.rationale: Deno 2 removed broad discovery exclusions and otherwise includes generated npm and Node port tests outside the immutable source suite.

decisions.decision: Prefer an exact finite-domain luminance transfer lookup if no smaller V8-compatible power implementation exists.
decisions.rationale: TinyColor rounds luminance channels to 8-bit integers; Go math.Pow differs from V8 for 93 of 245 nonlinear channels and heuristic ULP correction is incorrect.
